rules.text: Schonox ST can be used with Sika approved water-based under tile waterproofing membranes.
rules.heading: DESCRIPTION

rules.text: Schonox ST can be used with Sikalastic 1K membrane.
rules.heading: DESCRIPTION

rules.text: For use with Sikalastic 1K waterproofing membrane
rules.heading: USES

rules.text: For use with Sika approved under tile waterproofing membranes
rules.heading: USES

rules.text: Schonox AB system is not suitable for solvent based coatings.
rules.heading: IMPORTANT CONSIDERATIONS

rules.text: Sika approved water-based under tile membrane installations Schonox ST Tape & ST Corners Apply a single layer of membrane to wall/floor junctions and corners and place the Schonox ST corners onto the membrane
rules.heading: APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS

rules.text: Sikalastic 1K installations Schonox ST Tape & Corners Apply a single layer of Sikalastic 1K to wall/floor junctions and corners leaving a 10mm void directly under the wall floor junction and place the Schonox ST corners onto the membrane
rules.heading: APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS

rules.text: Apply an additional layer of Sikalstic 1K over lapping all edges Schonox ST D penetrations by a minimum 50mm. *For Sikalastic 1K applications that shall remain exposed and not covered by a tiling installation please apply Sikalastic 1K membrane to the entire face of the Schonox ST Tape. *Refer to Sikalastic 1K TDS for additional information.
rules.heading: APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS

rules.text: Schonox ST is used in conjunction with the following; Schonox AB waterproofing system Sika approved water based under tile waterproof membranes Sikalstic 1K For other similar sika products seek further technical advice from Sika Australia.
